email.subject: Tide Co Hair Studio — quick site fix idea
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Tide Co Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial your number manually instead of tapping to call, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open before they visit or call. Both are easy fixes.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change, no pressure either way.

Would this week work?

Alex
